invariants.text: A delete operation must remove the note from the database by its id, and must not affect other notes.
A note must have a unique id that is generated and assigned during creation.
A Note's title must be unique across all notes in the database.
If a note with a given title does not exist, a create operation must fail unless the title is explicitly allowed to be duplicated.
If a user attempts to delete a note that does not exist, the operation must fail.
Note.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The creation_date field of a Note must be set to the current timestamp when a note is created.
The creation_date of a note must not be modified after the note is created.
The list operation must return all notes in the database, sorted by creation_date in descending order.
The update operation must only modify the content of a note and must not alter its title or creation_date.
When a note is updated, its content may be modified, but the creation_date field must remain unchanged.
